theme: An open Saturday in St. Pete — the trip is what's waiting.
greeting: No meetings today, Dan, and the girls are with you and Mike. The whole day is yours — the best use of it is closing the Croatia bookings that have slipped past due before tomorrow's 9 AM review pulls them up.

needsAttention.detail: Your 15-minute board-clear with Mike is tomorrow morning. Everything below is what it will chase — walk in having booked or decided a few of these, not relitigating them live.

acts.line: A full house this weekend, with the four girls at yours and Mike's in St. Pete and nothing on the calendar to break the morning.
No meetings hold the middle of the day, so it is open for the Croatia bookings still sitting overdue on the board.
Tomorrow starts early with the 9 AM board review, one quiet thing worth teeing up tonight.
